page.title: Roles & Permissions
page.subtitle: Manage roles and their permissions
columns.name: Role Name
fields.name: Name
fields.clubHint: Leave empty to create a general (system-wide) role.
fields.portalRoleHint: Grants access to the admin portal. Users without a portal role cannot sign in to the web app.
fields.elevatedRoleHint: Elevated roles cannot be assigned to users shared across multiple organisations.
validation.nameMaxLength: Name must be 64 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionMaxLength: Description must be 500 characters or fewer.
permissions.description: Choose what users with this role can access.
permissions.summaryFew: You're giving access to a few areas.
permissions.summarySome: You're giving access to some areas.
permissions.summaryMost: You're giving access to most areas.
permissions.summaryFull: You're giving full access to all areas.
confirm.deactivate.title: Deactivate role?
confirm.deactivate.message: This will deactivate the '{{name}}' role. Users assigned this role will lose its permissions.
confirm.activate.title: Reactivate role?
confirm.activate.message: This will reactivate the '{{name}}' role. It can be assigned to users again.
confirm.permissions.title: Save permissions?
confirm.permissions.message: This will update the permissions for the '{{name}}' role. Changes take effect immediately.
confirm.save.editMessage: This will update the '{{name}}' role. Changes take effect immediately.
validation.noPermissions: At least one permission must be selected.
deactivate.modal.title: Deactivate '{{name}}'?
deactivate.modal.description: This will deactivate the '{{name}}' role. It can be reactivated later.
deactivate.modal.blockedDescription: This role has {{count}} user(s) assigned. Reassign all users before deactivating.
deactivate.modal.reassignHint: Go to each user's profile and assign a different role, then return here to deactivate.
